label: sound
instruction_covers: Positive deltas from advance and update(completed=...) feed one rate estimate over the sampling window
Zero/negative deltas update completed but add no rate evidence
Task.speed = completed steps / elapsed time between retained samples
time_remaining uses rate and ceils remaining work, None when no estimate
Reaching finite total via update sets finished, finished_time, finished_speed, frozen afterward
reset clears rate evidence, keeps total, allows fresh estimate
Backward compatibility of fields, rendering, indeterminate tasks
reason: Every hidden test behaviour (exact speed formulas, freezing on finish, reset/total-change invalidation, ceil'd ETA) is explicitly stated in the instruction; test specifics like approx or helper classes are library calls, not fix requirements.
